validation_rules: copy only artifacts hash-bound by the exact draft publication manifest
derive SARIF only from exact report citations matching the independently verified trace
latest append-only human signoff must carry a keyed authorization for the exact report hash and chain to the externally trusted ledger anchor
require a complete evidence-bound completeness audit and terminal bounded feedback record
re-derive current publication preparation so approval cannot bypass newer quorum rescope or remediation/retest blockers
retain the exact publication-preparation decision in the final package
reserve publisher-owned paths and reverify the closed final tree before atomic publication
publish atomically and never replace an existing final package
reject changed missing linked or escaping draft artifacts
